notes: MSFS Asobo 747 support package: install/update can no longer leave a broken package; it is not touched while MSFS uses it, is checked first, and the previous package is restored on failure.
PSX: knob turns and presses made while PSX was disconnected are no longer sent in a burst when it reconnects.
PMDG/MSFS: no more connection-helper restarts every few seconds while the simulator is closed; a lost simulator connection is restarted automatically. Logs no longer grow without limit.
